Hi Elena — thanks for the files and for laying out the timeline. I pulled together a decision-path matrix that highlights legal/procurement touchpoints and three suggested paths depending on how quickly your procurement team can move:

1) Fast-track (preferred): sign our standard MSA + DPA within 2 weeks, order form to follow. Provision hosted evaluation in parallel; convert to Dedicated only after order form execution.
2) Parallel approach: start hosted evaluation after DPA signature only (MSA signed later). This reduces time-to-eval but requires written acceptance from your Security team for hosted processing.
3) Conservative: full MSA + DPA + executed order form before any data ingress — recommended for regulated pilots.

Action items for us:
- Karthik: can legal confirm whether the DPA we provide can be counter-signed independently from the MSA? Any clauses likely to add review time (data residency, subprocessor list)?
- Elena/procurement: when can you share your PO timeline and reviewer names?

I'm attaching the MAP export I created with tentative milestone dates and owners. If we align on path 1 or 2 we can begin the eval the week of June 23.

Thanks,

Elena / Ava — quick legal perspective:

- We can accept a DPA signature ahead of the MSA for the purposes of provisioning hosted test environments, but we need an explicit limited-scope Addendum that ties the DPA to the evaluation only and includes a stop-gap subprocessor list for the pilot. That cuts review time (~3 business days) vs. a full MSA counter-sign.
- Data residency: if HelioMed will route PHI-adjacent content we need to confirm region (US-EAST vs. EU) and apply the appropriate SCCs or state-specific controls. That will add a week if you require local hosting.
- Order form: reserved capacity (Dedicated) onboarding requires an executed order form before we allocate GPUs. Hosted evals do not. If procurement prefers to have a PO in place it will lengthen the critical path.

Risk callouts: indemnity caps and audit rights in the MSA often trigger procurement counsel iterations. If we keep the pilot scope limited and add a 30-day rollback clause, we can often accelerate signature.

I'll attach a recommended short Addendum template and mark the clauses I expect counters on.

Karthik Iyer
